title: is_valid_group_name diverges from stoa_core::GroupName validation
description: The ActivityPub mod.rs uses a local is_valid_group_name (requires dot, no whitespace) while the rest of the system uses stoa_core::article::GroupName::new() which has its own validation rules. If the rules diverge, valid groups in the NNTP layer may be rejected by AP endpoints, or invalid names accepted by AP endpoints. A future maintainer adding AP routes will likely copy is_valid_group_name rather than finding GroupName::new, creating a recurring class of inconsistency bugs. Fix: replace is_valid_group_name with GroupName::new(name).is_ok().
